title: Camp Indigo Point

heroGallery.alt: Campers dance beneath a rainbow disco ball at camp

hero.heading: Camp. With your people.
hero.summary: Swimming. Friendship bracelets. Queer prom. Counselors who get you. A summer of being a kid, with people who understand.
details: 150 LGBTQ+ campers from 33 states, surrounded by queer counselors and leaders.
Ordinary summer camp. A community that can change how you see your future.

quickFacts: Overnight summer camp in the Midwest

sections.heading: A lot of camp. A lot of being yourself.
sections.body: At Indigo Point, queerness is something we share. You don’t have to explain it before you can make a friend, try archery, or get really into arts and crafts. Our campers spend their days doing the things kids do at summer camp, surrounded by LGBTQ+ peers and queer grown-ups who show them what a future can look like.
